shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST ProtectedPath resources

options.name: abort
options.description: abort the failover process

options.name: capabilities
options.description:
Indicates if the protected path supports global access streams (\"STARED_GLOBAL_NAMESPACE\") or async replication
streams (\"ASYNC_REPLICATION\") or a single stream for synchronous replication (\"SYNC_REPLICATION\") or both
global access and async replication (\"REPLICATION_AND_GN\").

options.name: enabled
options.description: enable/pause protected path

options.name: failover
options.description: Trigger failover command

options.name: graceful
options.description: graceful failover

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: lease_expiry_time
options.description:
The lease expiry time, in seconds, for a global access protected path. This is the duration for which data that
was already requested at the destination path can be read locally from cache without the destination peer
requesting it from the source peer. When the lease expires, the cache is invalidated and the next read request
for the data is requested again from the source peer.

options.name: name
options.description: Name

options.name: policy_id
options.description: Protection policy ID Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: protection_policy_id
options.description: protection policy id

options.name: remote_target_id
options.description: Remote target ID for streams with global namespace or synchronous replication capability.

options.name: remote_tenant_guid
options.description: Tenant GUID of the remote peer tenant to which to replicate

options.name: replication_policy_id
options.description: replication policy id

options.name: source_dir
options.description: path to replicate

options.name: source_member_capabilities
options.description: Stream capabilities for the source member

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: sync_disconnect_time
options.description:
A period of time, in seconds, without communication between sync replication peers, after which the peers are
disconnected.\"

options.name: sync_interval
options.description:
Minimal duration since the last snapshot shared between all destination peers in a replication group. Applicable
if the protected path has more than one replication stream.

options.name: target_exported_dir
options.description: where to replicate on the remote

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: Tenant ID of the tenant on the local cluster to which the source_dir belongs.

options.name: view_replication_enabled
options.description: Manages view replication Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
